name: Fire Elemental
description: An elemental is a powerful fusion of raw magic and elements resulting in a formidable foe that can channel magic. Elementals are typically prevalent in groups and in locations that are infused with ancient magic or extraplanar energy.

actions.name: Fire Whip
actions.description: The Fire Elemental spawns a whip of pure flame and makes an attack with it, dealing fire damage. If the Fire Elemental scores a true hit, the target is ignited.

actions.name: Fiery Vengeance
actions.description: In response to taking damage from a melee attack, the Fire Elemental enhances their Flame Shield trait to deal an additional 2d6 fire damage.

actions.name: Absorb Flame
actions.description: The Fire Elemental absorbs a non-magical flame that occupies a space less than 1 square units and extinguishes it. If the Fire Elemental finishes channeling a spell on this turn, it becomes charged and has a 1d4 attack bonus.

actions.name: Attack of Opportunity
actions.description: In response to a creature leaving the Fire Elemental's area of control, it makes an attack against them with it's Fire Whip action.

actions.name: Tornado of Fire
actions.description: The Fire Elemental spends some of it's essence to briefly turn into whirling tornado of flames, expanding itself out in a 2 unit radius dealing fire damage. The Fire Elemental takes 2d4 true damage after making this attack.

traits.name: Elemental
traits.description: Elementals have special protection against physical damage from weapons and ammunition that do not have the magical property, halving any damage before mitigations are applied.

traits.name: Essence of Fire
traits.description: The Fire Elemental gives off 3 units of light and becomes dazed until the end of it's next turn when targeted with spells or effects that extinguish magical fire.

traits.name: Flame Shield
traits.description: Whenever a creature hits the Fire Elemental with a melee attack, they take 2d6 fire damage.
